blocks.text: That Jacob Chase directed Blumhouse Atomic and Universal movie we told you about in August, Sleepover , well, Michelle Monaghan and Justin Theroux are leading it. The pic remains dated for Oct. 8, 2027.

The Insidious: Out of the Further filmmaker is helming off a screenplay he co-penned with Night Swim ‘s Bryce McGuire, which is based on the latter’s original short story. The project is billed as the “quintessential sleepover nightmare”. Jason Blum is producing. Chase, McGuire and Bea Sequeira will serve as executive producers. Sequeira serve as EP for Blumhouse and Lilly Tyson overseeing the project for the company. Jason Blum is producing.

blocks.text: Parker Posey was previously announced for the project. The Golden Globes and Critics Choice nominated Monaghan is now taking over her role.
The news follows Blumhouse’s L.A. symposium today, The Business of Fear.
The Devil Wears Prada 2 , The Leftovers ) are set to star in Sleepover, a horror feature from director Jacob Chase ( Insidious: Out of the Further ), for Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic.
Sleepover is a Cinescape Entertainment production, presented by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic

Monaghan was most recently seen in Netflix’s The Whisper Man . Upcoming she has Netflix’s drama series, The Sticks , as well as Your Friends and Neighbors for Apple. She starred in Mission: Impossible – Fallout, Gone Baby Gone, True Detective and the 2025 season of HBO’s White Lotus . Monaghan shared an acting ensemble Critics Choice nomination for Gone Baby Gone in 2008 and was nominated for a Golden Globe for True Detective in 2015 in TV Supporting Actress. Theroux is a two-time Emmy winning actor, writer, producer, and creator who can most recently be seen in the Netflix hit series Running Point as well as Amazon Prime’s Fallout , and will next be seen in the Apple TV limited series Wild Things opposite Jude Law and Andrew Garfield. Theroux also stars opposite Jenna Ortega, Michael Keaton, and Winona Ryder in Beetlejuice Beetlejuice for Warner Bros as well as The Devil Wears Prada 2. Theroux is also coming off a Critics Choice Award nomination for his work in HBO’s limited series White House Plumbers opposite Woody Harrelson. Monaghan is represented by Gersh, Anonymous Content, Entertainment 360, and Sloane, Offer, Weber & Dern. Theroux is represented by CAA, Lighthouse Management & Media, and Toczek Suddleson Law Group.
Chase’s Insidious: Out of the Further is the second highest grossing in the 16-year old franchise minting $172M worldwide.
